name: FFS_ST_SLT_DATA
description: Stores all "street level" routing service results to be included into travel statistics.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier of this record.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Defines if this record should be included into the statistics.

columns.name: FROM_ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: ID of origin activity. '0' ID value denotes 'start travel'.

columns.name: FROM_LOCATION_ID
columns.description: In case of 'start travel', it contains an ID of the start location.

columns.name: FROM_COORD_STATUS
columns.description: Defines if there are valid coordinates.

columns.name: FROM_COORD_X
columns.description: X coordinate (Longitude) of the source.

columns.name: FROM_COORD_Y
columns.description: Y coordinate (Latitude) of the source.

columns.name: TO_ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: ID of destination activity. '0' ID value denotes 'final travel'.

columns.name: TO_LOCATION_ID
columns.description: In case of 'final travel', it contains an ID of the final location.

columns.name: TO_COORD_STATUS
columns.description: Defines if there are valid coordinates.

columns.name: TO_COORD_X
columns.description: X coordinate (Longitude) of the destination.

columns.name: TO_COORD_Y
columns.description: Y coordinate (Latitude) of the destination.

columns.name: TRAVEL_DISTANCE
columns.description: Estimated travel distance in meters.

columns.name: TRAVEL_DURATION
columns.description: Street level travel time in minutes.

columns.name: TRAVEL_DURATION_DEVIATION
columns.description: Possible deviation of the estimated travel time value; Minutes.

columns.name: WEIGHT
columns.description: Weightage assigned to the record for computational purposes.

columns.name: CREATED
columns.description: Creation time of this street level data record.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
